messages:
Sam: CI red on linux-arm nightly — tests/serve/test_retry.py::ServeRetryOrderingTest::test_interleaved_retries is flaking repeatedly on master (3f7a2b2). Job: builders/arm64-serve-tests#457. Can someone kick off a quick triage?
ci-bot: Build FAILED — test failed: tests/serve/test_retry.py::ServeRetryOrderingTest::test_interleaved_retries (exit 1). Artifacts: https://ci.internal/builds/457/logs 
Leila: @Sam can you paste the failing stdout / tail of the job? also which commit exactly? :thinking:
Sam: commit 3f7a2b2... pushed yesterday. Tail from the failing run:
```
E   AssertionError: Expected call order [A B] but got [B A]
...
runtime/session.go:214 +0x45
runtime/retry.go:87 +0x1f
```
Matt: hmm timing-sensitive for sure. Looks like ordering in the retry path. @Ravi did you change any timers / prefetch recently?
Ravi: I touched prefetch scheduling last week but didn't touch retry logic. I'll try a local stress and report back. What command did CI run?
Sam: CI command is: 
```
CI_RUNNER=arm64 pytest tests/serve/test_retry.py::ServeRetryOrderingTest::test_interleaved_retries -q -k interleaved --maxfail=1
```
Ravi: ran 50 iterations under qemu-arm, reproduced on iteration 12. Local trace (truncated):
```
--- iteration 12 ---
[INFO] session init
[DEBUG] enqueuing retry for req-42
[DEBUG] evicting kv-cache chunk
AssertionError: call order mismatch (B before A)
```
Leila: if it's reproducible locally we should bisect. @Matt can you run git-bisect using the same harness? If bisectable we can find the commit range quickly.
Matt: I'll spin up an arm64 runner and run a bisect script. If it's nondeterministic, we should reduce noise: try TEST_SEED=42 and set TEST_ITER=200.
Sam: I also created a tiny repro script that toggles tiny sleeps around the allocator; posted at https://git.internal/repro/serve-retry-flake (contains small snippet with `time.Sleep(500 * time.Microsecond)` adjustments).
ci-bot: Re-run triggered by @Matt — builders/arm64-serve-tests#458.
Ravi: quick experiment — introducing a tiny mutex around the session allocator made my local runs stable (100/100). Suspect a race between allocator and retry path. I'll prepare a PR with a minimal locking patch + test harness.
Leila: good plan. In the meantime I'll mark the test as flaky/quarantined in test metadata so we stop getting noise in nightlies. I'll add flaky:quarantine label. :white_check_mark:
Matt: bisect results (prelim): commit range narrowed to 3f7a2b2..4a9f1c8 where the behavior changes. Ravi's patch seems to address the regression. Any objections to force-merge after CI green?
Sam: no objections. Once Ravi's PR lands and CI is green we can un-quarantine and monitor. Thanks all for quick turnaround. :rocket:
